theme: Light theme preferred for legal/government forms to maintain high contrast, authority, and clarity. Optional dark mode for Admin Dashboard.

headings.strategy: Swiss Brutalist - sharp, clean, tightly tracked.

body.strategy: High legibility, tabular numerals for currency amounts.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Crisp edges, semi-transparent borders + subtle ambient shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-md).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 for forms and cards. No soft UI/neumorphism.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain or noise on hero background for a premium, grounded feel.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Flat solid colors for form containers to prevent refraction.

grids_and_layouts.homepage: Bento grid for features and Q&A. Asymmetrical layout for hero.
grids_and_layouts.form: 2-column layout on desktop: Left column for form sections (First Party, Second Party, Stamp Details), Right column for sticky 'Auto-save Status' and 'Document Summary'.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High density grid. Sidebar navigation, top bar for global actions, main content area with data-heavy tables.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing (p-8 to p-16) for marketing sections. Dense spacing (p-4, gap-4) for admin tables and multi-step forms.

components.navigation: Sticky header with clear DocGalaxy brand. Logo left, navigation links center, Login/CTA right.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Implement a Combobox for 'Description of Document' (searchable Gujarat stamp duty articles). Labels must be legible, fields must support optional states clearly.
components.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md) for trust. High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
components.tables: Shadcn Table with tabular-nums for currency. Sticky header. Badges for Status (Draft, Submitted, Paid, Unpaid).
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg for interactivity.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Explicit focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500) for accessibility.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion staggered fade-in for form sections and dashboard rows.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard compliant. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.aria: All form fields must have aria-labels. Decorative icons must have aria-hidden='true'.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='estamping-form').

images.description: Collection of stamps, to be used in Hero section or About section.
Clean architectural lines, good for Auth page background or hero texture.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React application using Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Implement the customer auth (Mobile + Name + OTP) and admin auth (Email + Password). Mock backend/OTP flow if necessary but ensure full UI experience.
For the E-Stamping application form, use a multi-section layout. Implement a Combobox/Searchable dropdown for 'Description of Document' (Gujarat stamp duty articles).
All fields in the E-Stamping form must be optional. Implement auto-save as draft feature visually.
After form submission, render it in a read-only state.
Admin dashboard must include an orders table with Paid/Unpaid toggles, Review moderation, and a 'Generate Autofill Bookmarklet' button.
Ensure SEO tags (H1/H2, schema markup, OG tags) are structured properly on the homepage targeting 'estamping' keyword.
Do NOT use 'transition: all' in CSS. Specify transitions explicitly (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, or uniform styling.
Do not center align the App container (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with proper padding and hover states.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
